battle.name: 第三次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭
battle.theater: 奧爾沙河谷與維捷布斯克邊境
battle.brief: 一五〇七年，伊凡三世藉利沃尼亞騎士團之亂開戰，莫斯科大軍西進，立陶宛-波蘭聯軍九月在奧爾沙以騎兵側翼衝鋒擊潰俄軍；一五〇八年舒伊斯基兩度圍維捷布斯克與奧爾沙皆無功，十月八日訂下永久和平。戰役火力仍靠火繩步槍與攻城重砲，輪發手槍只配火槍隊軍官與近衛，用於夜哨與近身自衛。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 此役的交戰方看起來是兩個國家，實際是三條戰線加一個修院國家。東方是莫斯科大公國：伊凡三世以炮匠院統管火砲、火藥、火器匠與攻城器械，軍隊骨幹是服役土地供養的世襲軍與各城市按份攤派徵召的役夫，貴族與軍頭各領自己的披甲侍從隊作戰，決策集中在大公書房，南方還要留兵警戒克里米亞汗國與喀山汗國的游騎，因此每次西征能投入的兵力都有限。西方是立陶宛大公國兼波蘭王國：齊格蒙特一世坐鎮維爾納，樞密院與大貴族共同分擔決策，國家軍隊以立陶宛與白俄羅斯貴族的重騎兵為主軸，配板甲、長柄波蘭矛與彎刀，步兵大量僱用德意志、波希米亞與西里西亞的傭兵，這些傭兵隊長在火器與築城技術上往往比本國貴族更有話語權，羅馬天主教的傳教士也隨之進入立陶宛東境。北方是條頓騎士團與利沃尼亞騎士團：大團長阿爾布雷希特拒絕向波蘭效忠，一五〇六年出兵侵入波蘭領土，逼迫利沃尼亞同宗撕毀休戰、越境襲擊波洛茨克一線，立陶宛於是淪為兩支德意志騎士團之間的戰場，莫斯科則自居為利沃尼亞的援助者，把這條邊境衝突變成向西開戰的槓桿。
countriesEn: The belligerents here look like two states, but in truth they are three fronts plus one order-state. In the east was the Grand Duchy of Moscow: Ivan III centralised the guns, the powder, the gunsmiths and the siege engines in the artillery yard; the backbone of his army was a service army fed by service land together with levies raised share by share in the towns; boyars and captains each led their own armoured retinuses into the field; decisions were taken in the grand prince's chancery; and troops had to be held back in the south to watch the Crimean Khanate and Kazan, which capped the strength of every western column. In the west was the Grand Duchy of Lithuania together with the Kingdom of Poland: Sigismund I sat in Vilnius and the council and the great magnates shared the decisions between them; the national army had as its axis the heavy horse of the Lithuanian and Belarussian nobility, clad in plate and carrying the long kontusz and a sabre, while the foot was largely hired from Germany, Bohemia and Silesia, and these mercenary captains had more to say about firearms and fortification than native nobles did, with Roman Catholic missionaries following the same road into the eastern provinces. In the north were the Teutonic and Livonian Orders: Grand Master Albrecht refused to do homage to Poland, marched into Polish territory in 1506, and forced his Livonian kin to tear up the truce and raid across the Polotsk line, so that Lithuania became the battleground between the two German orders, while Moscow cast itself as the helper of Livonia and turned that border quarrel into the lever for a war to the west.
people: 全場最關鍵的是伊凡三世與齊格蒙特一世這對老對手。伊凡三世在二戰之後並未停手：一五〇二年休戰到期，他照舊主張斯摩棱斯克、維亞澤馬等羅斯王公采地應歸大公國，又以立陶宛違約掩護叛逃者、干預利沃尼亞為由向齊格蒙特提出通牒，並向利沃尼亞騎士團許諾，只要立陶宛支持條頓騎士團，莫斯科就出兵相助，日後還可把普斯科夫交給騎士團。齊格蒙特一世自一五〇六年起以波蘭國王兼立陶宛大公的雙重身分應戰，他必須同時應付三條戰線：波蘭王國的貴族與波羅的海的條頓衝突、白俄羅斯邊境上的立陶宛領地，以及莫斯科的進攻。立陶宛最高軍事首領康斯坦丁·奧斯特羅斯基是戰場上的決定性人物：一五〇七年九月八日奧爾沙之戰，他以少量騎兵迂迴側翼，擊潰遠多於己方的俄軍，是這場戰爭裡立陶宛唯一一場乾淨的野戰勝利。莫斯科一方的統帥是瓦西里·伊萬諾維奇·舒伊斯基，這位王室血親在領兵圍攻維捷布斯克與奧爾沙時屢攻不克，退兵與損失主要由他承擔；丹尼爾·謝尼亞與德米特里·沃洛奇克等人各領別的縱隊作戰。南方草原上是克里米亞汗明里·格來，他的部眾不斷襲擾莫斯科南境，逼得伊凡三世分兵。北方則有利沃尼亞騎士團的團長與議會，以及拒絕向波蘭效忠的條頓騎士團大團長阿爾布雷希特，這兩個團的處境直接決定東線能不能打得起來。
peopleEn: The two men who mattered most were Ivan III and Sigismund I, old adversaries. Ivan III had not stopped after the second war: when the truce of 1502 ran out he renewed his old claim that the appanages of Smolensk, Vyazma and the other Rus princes belonged by right to the grand prince, and he sent Sigismund an ultimatum on the ground that Lithuania had broken the treaty by harbouring fugitives and interfering in Livonia, promising the Livonian Order that as long as Lithuania supported the Teutonic Order Moscow would send troops to help, and that Pskov might one day be handed over to the order. Sigismund I, from 1506 onward, fought as king of Poland and grand duke of Lithuania at once and had to answer on three fronts at the same time: the magnates of Poland and the Teutonic quarrel in the Baltic, the Lithuanian lands on the Belarussian frontier, and the Muscovite invasion. The decisive figure on the field was Konstanty Ostrogski, the highest military commander of Lithuania: at the battle of Orsha on 8 September 1507 he wheeled a small body of horse around the flank and routed a Russian host far larger than his own, the one clean field victory Lithuania won in the whole war. On the Muscovite side the commander was Vasili Ivanovich Shuysky, a prince of the ruling house who failed in his sieges of Vitebsk and Orsha and carried the blame for the costly withdrawal; men such as Daniil Shchenya and Dmitry Volchok led other columns. On the southern steppe stood the Crimean khan Meñli I Giray, whose bands kept raiding the southern provinces of Moscow and forced Ivan to divide his forces. In the north sat the master and the council of the Livonian Order, together with Albrecht, grand master of the Teutonic Order, who refused to do homage to Poland; the position of those two orders decided whether the eastern front could be opened at all.
kits: 此役的裝備骨架是火繩槍、長矛、騎槍與攻城重砲。莫斯科的射手用俄式火藥槍，一種以火繩點火的滑膛長槍，站成稀疏散兵線並靠支架分組射擊，步兵另配長矛、闊刃長柄刀與弩，貴族重騎用板甲、長柄波蘭矛與彎刀；圍城時把野戰重砲推上土木砲壘，一五〇八年維捷布斯克城下就有成排重砲與石彈的記載。立陶宛-波蘭聯軍的骨幹是重騎兵與德意志、波希米亞傭兵步兵，傭兵帶來的是歐洲式火繩步槍與攻城砲術，卡在它們與立陶宛騎兵之間的，就是各類手槍。卡面這件輪發手槍恰好站在這個轉折點上：機構約在一五〇〇年前後出現於低地國家，靠發條帶動的鋼輪撞擊燧石發火，不用火繩，卻要轉動十幾圈才能上弦，機件怕潮、耗藥多，價錢是火繩手槍的數倍，所以只配給火槍隊的軍官與近衛，屬於身份與榮譽的配件而非戰鬥主力。就一五〇七至一五〇八年的東線而言，配發紀錄幾乎空白，可以確定的仍是：會戰與圍城裡真正開火的是火繩手槍，輪發手槍最可能的去處是德意志與波希米亞傭兵首領、立陶宛大公近衛以及莫斯科火槍隊軍官的手上，用於雨雪夜哨、近身自衛和對付衝到馬前的落馬敵騎。除此之外，兩軍的後勤同樣決定成敗：牛車與騾車組成的車隊運糧運彈藥，白俄羅斯鄉村的穀物、牲畜與冬季宿營地是遠征軍隊的生存基礎，沒有戰地醫院，只有隨軍的草藥師與巫醫，通信全靠信使與驛站，命令常在傳遞中走樣，攻城最終仍由砲射程、城牆厚度與季節決定勝負。
kitsEn: The equipment skeleton of this war was matchlock firearm, pike, lance and heavy gun. The Muscovite shooters carried the Russian matchlock arquebus, a heavy smooth-bored piece fired from a match, standing in a thin skirmish line and working in sections off their rests, while the foot had pikes, broad-bladed pole blades and crossbows, and the armoured boyar horse carried plate, the long kontusz and a sabre; in sieges the field guns were pushed up onto earthworks, and the massed heavy guns and stone shot before Vitebsk in 1508 are on record. The backbone of the Lithuanian and Polish allies was the heavy horse together with German and Bohemian mercenary foot, and those mercenaries brought the European matchlock arquebus and the craft of the siege gun; what sat between them and the Lithuanian cavalry were the handguns of every kind. The wheellock pistol on the card stands exactly at this turning point: the mechanism appeared in the Low Countries around 1500, a spring-driven steel wheel striking pyrite to produce the flash, needing no match but demanding a dozen or more turns of the crank to cock, vulnerable to damp, thirsty for powder and costing several times a matchlock pistol, so that it was issued only to the officers of the firearm companies and to the guards, an accessory of rank and honour rather than an instrument of battle. For the eastern front of 1507 and 1508 the records of issue are almost blank, and what can be established is that the pistols which actually fired in the battles and the sieges were still matchlocks; the wheellock's likeliest holders were the German and Bohemian mercenary captains, the household guard of the Lithuanian grand duke and the officers of the Muscovite firearm companies, using it for night watch in rain and snow, for personal defence at close quarters and against unhorsed enemies who closed to the muzzle. Beyond the firearms, logistics decided as much: trains of ox carts and mule wagons carried grain and powder, the grain, livestock and winter camp sites of the Belarussian villages were the living basis of every distant column, there was no field hospital but only camp herbalists and sorcerers, communication ran on messengers and relay stations and orders were often distorted in transit, and in the end sieges were settled by the range of the guns, the thickness of the walls and the season.
tactics: 莫斯科的打法是分進合擊加冬季攻堅，而不是求一次會戰的勝負。一五〇七年出兵，莫斯科主力沿斯摩棱斯克大道西進，另有一支指向別列津納河上游，同時以利沃尼亞騎士團在北面牽制立陶宛的立窩尼亞邊境，目的不是攻下某一座城，而是把立陶宛的注意力拉散、把白俄羅斯鄉村搜刮乾淨，逼維爾納回到談判桌前。會戰發生在一五〇七年九月八日的奧爾沙：立陶宛-波蘭聯軍不與俄軍正面硬撞，而以騎兵在陣前迂迴、待俄軍隊形拉開後從側翼與背後切進，步兵與砲兵同時壓上，俄軍中軍被截斷，營帳、輜重與砲車盡失，數百人被俘，餘部向斯摩棱斯克方向潰退。一五〇八年莫斯科改為圍城：瓦西里·舒伊斯基先攻維捷布斯克，用壕壘與封鎖配合重砲，圍了數月不得入，糧秣耗盡而退；同年再圍奧爾沙，守軍在圍城期間出城反擊，又靠堅城與冬寒消耗攻城方，等到深秋疫病與糧道同時出問題，攻城方只能解圍而去。立陶宛的守城辦法寫在它自己的編年史裏：不在野地與莫斯科的步槍隊硬拼，用騎兵襲擊俄軍側翼與糧道，把游騎隊擺在森林與沼澤邊緣拖住追兵，讓追擊自己停下來。整體看，這場戰爭的勝負手不在任何一次會戰，而在糧道長度、冬營保暖與圍城的季節。
tacticsEn: Muscovite method was converging columns combined with winter siege, not a single decisive engagement. The army that marched in 1507 drove west along the Smolensk road, with another column pushed towards the upper Berezina, while the Livonian Order held the Lithuanian-Livonian border in the north; the aim was not to take any particular town but to scatter Lithuanian attention, strip the Belarussian countryside bare and force Vilnius back to the negotiating table. The battle came on 8 September 1507 at Orsha. The Lithuanian and Polish allies refused to strike the Russian host head-on: their horse wheeled wide in front of the enemy, cut into the flank and the rear once the Russian line had stretched, infantry and guns pressed at the same time, the Russian centre was cut through, tents, baggage and gun carriages were lost, several hundred men were taken prisoner, and the rest broke towards Smolensk. In 1508 Moscow changed to siege: Vasili Shuysky first invested Vitebsk, combining trench and blockade with heavy guns, and after months without taking it withdrew for want of food; later the same year he besieged Orsha, where the garrison answered with sallies and used the strength of the walls and the cold to wear down the besiegers, until in late autumn disease and the failing supply line together forced the army to lift the siege. The Lithuanian way of holding a town is written into its own chronicles: do not trade blows with the Muscovite firearm companies in the open field, but send the horse against the Russian flank and supply line, post the light horse along the edge of the woods and the marshes to hold the pursuers up and let the pursuit exhaust itself. Taken as a whole, this war was not decided by any single battle but by the length of the supply line, the warmth of the winter camp and the season in which the sieges were fought.
data: 可核對的數字集中在幾個節點上。戰爭自一五〇七年初起（出師月份在文獻中記載不一，普遍視為初春），到一五〇八年十月八日訂立永久和平止，前後約一年半。會戰只有一場有確定日期：一五〇七年九月八日奧爾沙之戰，按俄曆舊曆記法，與西方格里曆相差十日。雙方兵力的記載互相矛盾：立陶宛與波蘭方面的文件把俄軍寫到四萬以上，聯軍則記為一萬甚至更少；按十五世紀末至十六世紀初兩國的徵召能力推算，實際投入會戰的俄軍當在數千至一萬上下，立陶宛方面的騎兵規模則只有數千。被俘者多為軍頭與貴族，數百人。無人數字比較可靠：立陶宛軍在奧爾沙繳獲了俄軍的火砲、帳幕與糧草，數目在各方說法中不一。一五〇八年圍維捷布斯克的時間，編年史多記為自二月至夏，圍城數月而不能下；同年再圍奧爾沙，同樣以解圍告終。和約於一五〇八年十月八日在莫斯科簽訂，後經維爾納的會議確認，邊界回到一五〇三年的線上，斯摩棱斯克與維亞澤馬留在莫斯科手中，立陶宛另就利沃尼亞騎士團因條頓入侵而蒙的損失訂下賠付安排，金額在文獻中記載不一。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around a few fixed points. The war ran from the beginning of 1507 — the month in which the army set out is recorded inconsistently and is generally taken to be early spring — to the conclusion of the eternal peace on 8 October 1508, a matter of some eighteen months. Only one engagement has a firm date: the battle of Orsha on 8 September 1507, kept in the Russian old calendar, which ran ten days behind the Western Gregorian reckoning. The accounts of the two armies contradict one another: Lithuanian and Polish papers write the Russian host up at more than forty thousand and the allies at ten thousand or fewer; judged by the levy capacity of the two states in the late fifteenth and early sixteenth centuries, the Russians actually engaged were probably in the thousands up to about ten thousand, while the Lithuanian cavalry numbered only some thousands. The prisoners were mostly captains and nobles, several hundred men. No figure for the booty is dependable: the Lithuanian army took Russian guns, tents and grain at Orsha, but the amounts given in the various accounts disagree. The siege of Vitebsk in 1508 is placed by the chronicles between February and the summer, lasting several months without success; Orsha was besieged again the same year and likewise ended in a lifting of the siege. The peace was signed at Moscow on 8 October 1508 and confirmed by the diet at Vilnius: the frontier returned to the line of 1503, Smolensk and Vyazma stayed in Muscovite hands, and Lithuania entered a separate arrangement to make good the losses the Livonian Order had suffered from the Teutonic incursion, the sum being recorded inconsistently in the sources.
cause: 打起來的原因是幾條線纏在一起。第一條是邊界與采地：伊凡三世自一四九七年《莫斯科條約》之後就一直主張斯摩棱斯克、維亞澤馬等羅斯王公采地應歸大公國，一五〇二年的五十年休戰只是把爭議凍結，並沒有解決，一五〇七年莫斯科重新把這一條擺上桌面。第二條是利沃尼亞：阿爾布雷希特出任條頓騎士團大團長後拒絕向波蘭效忠，一五〇六年侵入波蘭領土，利沃尼亞同宗被迫越境襲擊波洛茨克一線，立陶宛視之為侵略；伊凡三世抓住這個機會，向利沃尼亞騎士團許諾只要立陶宛支持條頓騎士團，莫斯科就出兵相助，並暗示日後可把普斯科夫交給騎士團。莫斯科還指控立陶宛收留逃亡的羅斯王公與貴族、供給條頓騎士團金錢與傭兵，這些指控多難以逐一核實，卻正好構成開戰的公開理由。第三條是齊格蒙特一世的個人處境：他同時是波蘭國王與立陶宛大公，波蘭正因條頓問題與王位問題而內外交困，一旦莫斯科的騎兵越過維捷布斯克，他不可能再把西境完全交給樞密院。最後是時機：伊凡三世自一五〇五年起重整軍制、集中火砲、推行中央集權，已經具備單方面改變現狀的實力；南方草原有克里米亞與喀山的牽制，北方有利沃尼亞騎士團的配合，開戰的窗口就此打開。
causeEn: The fighting began from several threads wound together. The first was the frontier and the appanages: from the Treaty of Moscow of 1497 onward Ivan III maintained that Smolensk, Vyazma and the other appanages of the Rus princes belonged to the grand prince, and the fifty-year truce of 1502 had only frozen the dispute rather than settled it, so Moscow put the question back on the table in 1507. The second was Livonia: after Albrecht became grand master of the Teutonic Order he refused to do homage to Poland, marched into Polish territory in 1506, and his Livonian kin were driven to tear up the truce and raid across the Polotsk line, Lithuania treating it as an aggression; Ivan seized the opening and promised the Livonian Order that as long as Lithuania supported the Teutonic Order, Moscow would come to its aid, hinting that Pskov might later be handed over to the order. Moscow further accused Lithuania of sheltering fugitive Rus princes and nobles and of supplying the Teutonic Order with money and mercenaries; many of these accusations cannot be checked one by one, yet they served perfectly as the public reason for the war. The third was the personal position of Sigismund I: he was king of Poland and grand duke of Lithuania at once, Poland was being torn apart by the Teutonic question and by questions of the crown, and once Muscovite horse crossed beyond Vitebsk he could no longer leave the western lands entirely in the hands of the council. Last came the moment: since about 1505 Ivan III had reorganised the army, concentrated the artillery and tightened the centralising state, and now had the strength to change the situation on his own; the southern steppe held Moscow down through the Crimea and Kazan while the Livonian Order cooperated in the north, and the window for war was open.
impact: 這場戰爭沒有改變東歐的版圖，卻改變了幾個人的處境和一個行業的規模。對立陶宛來說，它保住了國家，卻把白俄羅斯邊境長期暴露在莫斯科的騎兵之下，連續三場戰爭的模板也由此定下：以短兵相接的圍城加冬季攻勢互相消耗，而不是一場會戰定江山。一五〇八年的和約裡最刺眼的一條，是立陶宛要為利沃尼亞騎士團因條頓入侵而受的損失作賠付安排，等於在自己與同族騎士團之間又劃開一道口子；莫斯科則藉承諾利沃尼亞、對付條頓，主動把自己放進波羅的海的棋盤裡，此後自一五〇八年起與利沃尼亞騎士團保持同盟，這條關係一直延續到一五二一年。對莫斯科而言，這一仗的帳單主要記在人力上：遠征消耗了大量服役兵與糧秣，南方還要同時應付草原，兵源與府庫都被抽薄；更深的後果在人事上——米哈伊爾·格林斯基在戰爭末段逃到立陶宛並且不肯被引渡，維爾納的樞密院因此分裂成國王派與樞密院派，莫斯科的貴族則認為瓦西里三世對他們的依附者保護不力，這道裂縫在下一場戰爭裡立刻爆開。技術上，圍維捷布斯克與圍奧爾沙兩次失敗，暴露了莫斯科重砲攻城在冬季後勤上的軟肋：一五〇八年之後，莫斯科的火砲鑄造與冬營制度都被迫改進，東線的攻城戰從此成為雙方都反覆演練的科目。真正被牽動的其實是波羅的海：條頓騎士團與波蘭的矛盾被擱置而未解，最終在一五一九至一五二一年演成波蘭-條頓戰爭，莫斯科正好趁那場戰爭騰出全力再向西打。
impactEn: This war changed no map of eastern Europe, but it changed the situation of several men and the scale of one industry. For Lithuania it saved the state, yet left the Belarussian frontier permanently exposed to Muscovite horse, and it fixed the template for the three wars that followed: mutual exhaustion by short siege and winter offensive rather than a single battle deciding everything. The sharpest clause of the peace of 1508 was the one obliging Lithuania to make good the losses the Livonian Order had suffered from the Teutonic incursion, which cut a fresh rift between the grand duchy and its own kin; Moscow, having promised Livonia and set itself against the Teutonic Order, placed itself deliberately on the Baltic board, and from 1508 onwards kept an alliance with the Livonian Order that ran on until 1521. For Moscow the bill of this war was paid mostly in men: the distant columns consumed a large part of the service army and its food, the south had to be held at the same time, and both manpower and treasury were thinned. The deeper consequence was personal: Mikhail Glinski fled to Lithuania in the closing phase of the war and refused to be handed over, the council at Vilnius split into a royal party and a council party over him, and the Muscovite boyars judged that Vasili III had failed to protect their clients, and that fissure burst open in the very next war. In technical terms, the two failed sieges of Vitebsk and Orsha exposed the weakness of Muscovite heavy siege artillery in winter logistics; after 1508 the casting of guns and the rules of the winter camp at Moscow were both forced to change, and the siege on the eastern line became a subject both sides drilled repeatedly. What was truly disturbed lay in the Baltic: the quarrel between the Teutonic Order and Poland was set aside unresolved and finally broke out as the Polish-Teutonic War of 1519 to 1521, and it was precisely in that war that Moscow found the strength to strike west once more.
result: 一五〇七年的秋季戰役以立陶宛-波蘭聯軍在奧爾沙的大勝告終，莫斯科第一次在會戰裡被立陶宛正面打敗，被俘的軍頭與貴族數百人，營帳、糧草與火砲被繳。一五〇八年莫斯科改打圍城，先後圍維捷布斯克與奧爾沙，皆因守軍抵抗、疫病與冬季糧秣不繼而無功，兩次圍城都沒有帶來任何城池的易手。戰爭最後以一五〇八年十月八日在莫斯科簽訂的永久和平收束，並在維爾納的會議上得到確認：邊界回到一五〇三年的線上，斯摩棱斯克與維亞澤馬留在莫斯科手中，立陶宛放棄對這些采地的所有權主張，另就利沃尼亞的損失與莫斯科方面的引渡要求另訂條款，戰俘問題雙方各執一端，沒有交換。表面看雙方都守住了自己的地盤：莫斯科保住了斯摩棱斯克，立陶宛保住了奧爾沙與維捷布斯克；實際上兩敗俱傷——莫斯科沒有拿到新土，還把大量兵力耗在西境，立陶宛則在和約裡欠下了新的債務與新的怨恨。和約簽下不到四年即告破裂：一五〇八年的格林斯基事件、瓦西里三世為寡嫂海倫娜與正教地位向維爾納提出的要求，以及莫斯科屢次支援利沃尼亞騎士團南下破約，最終在一五一二年間把第五次莫斯科-立陶宛戰爭重新點燃；一五一四年奧爾沙再戰，攻守易手，斯摩棱斯克重回立陶宛之手。
resultEn: The campaign of autumn 1507 ended in a clear Lithuanian and Polish victory at Orsha: Moscow was beaten in open battle by Lithuania for the first time, several hundred captains and nobles were taken prisoner, and tents, grain and guns fell to the winners. In 1508 Moscow turned to siege, investing Vitebsk and then Orsha, and both attempts came to nothing against the resistance of the garrisons, disease and the failure of the winter supply; not one town changed hands. The war ended with the eternal peace signed at Moscow on 8 October 1508 and confirmed by the diet at Vilnius: the frontier returned to the line of 1503, Smolensk and Vyazma stayed in Muscovite hands, Lithuania dropped its claims to those appanages, and separate clauses dealt with the Livonian losses and with the Moscow side's demand for the handing over of a fugitive, the prisoners being left unexchanged on each side. On the surface both held their ground, Moscow keeping Smolensk and Lithuania keeping Orsha and Vitebsk; in truth both were worn out, Moscow gaining no new soil and spending a great part of its strength in the west, Lithuania acquiring fresh debts and fresh grievances in the peace. The settlement broke down in under four years: the Glinski affair of 1508, the demands Vasili III made at Vilnius on behalf of his widowed sister Helena and for the standing of the Orthodox, and the repeated Muscovite support for Livonian raids into Lithuania, all combined to relight the war in the years around 1512. Orsha was fought again in 1514, the sides exchanged places, and Smolensk returned to Lithuanian hands.
